tools.name: keyword_research
tools.description: Score one App Store or Google Play search keyword. Returns popularity, difficulty (0-100, how hard the current top ten is to beat, from their ratings and how well their names match), opportunity (demand discounted by the chance of reaching the top ten; 30 or more is usually worth a place in the app

tools.name: keyword_ideas
tools.description: Find the searches a store suggests around a seed keyword: its autocomplete expanded a level deep, up to 60 phrases, with popularity where it's measured. Phrases marked app_name are other apps' names, which are rarely worth targeting. Use keyword_research on the ones that describe the app. Popularity

tools.name: app_ranks
tools.description: Where one app ranks today for up to five keywords, read from the store's live search results in the country asked for. rank null means not in the results checked (checked_top, up to 50 on the App Store). Also names the app just above it. Give the app as a store link, an App Store id, a Play package

tools.name: search_apps
tools.description: Search the App Store or Google Play by name and get up to six apps with their id, developer, rating, number of ratings and store link. Use it to find an app's id before app_ranks, or to see who a competitor is.

tools.name: check_metadata
tools.description: Count an App Store or Google Play listing against the stores' character limits, the way the stores count (Apple's keyword field is 100 bytes).
